reply.thought: I will list orders and refunds to identify affected customers, then query net_balance per customer and record one payout per customer for their net amount.
Now I will list refunds to confirm which orders were refunded in this batch, then compute net balances per affected customer via net_balance and record payouts.
Refunds were applied for orders 121, 122, and 124; affected customers are birch and cobalt. I will query net_balance for each customer and record one payout per customer.
Birch net balance is available; I will record a payout for that amount, then query cobalt net balance.
Now I will get cobalt's net balance and record its payout.
Cobalt net balance is available; I will record a payout for that amount. Then finish with a report of payouts.
All affected customers have been paid their net balances (orders minus refunds). Finishing report.
